'''Rock Leader''' was the callsign of the leader of [[Rock Squadron]]. The position was held by [[Nakk Kech]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], and [[Timmser]] successively in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].
